limits: Artifact creation and integration are not stage entry or completion.
First is path-history topology, not oldest wall-clock timestamp; renames and repeated additions are ambiguous.
Main integration time is Git committer time, not GitHub mergedAt; main is the locally available pinned ref, never fetched here.
Missing or shallow history cannot establish absence. Legacy versions and pre-brief reusable infrastructure do not qualify the current contract.
Calendar milestones are not effort, blocked time, spend or measured time saved. TESTED requires #970 plus the owner's cheap-baseline comparison.

limit: Reports source-backed draft/gap/snapshot progress. No stage exit is adjudicated from file presence; independent stage acceptance remains with #970 owners.

stages.definition_note: Selecting a Challenge stays the owner's; nothing here admits one.
stages.name: Brief
stages.next_required: A one-page brief naming the buyer role, the decision and the value at stake, with sources or labelled assumptions.

stages.definition_note: The owner-session mapping is UNVERIFIED; the sections and exit are verified.
stages.name: Design packet
stages.next_required: The ten sections of COMMON_DESIGN_PACKET_V1 filled with source-linked facts; every value without an owner decision or evidence is OPEN with owner, needed decision and held-closed behavior.

stages.definition_note: The specs are SPECIFIED, not built or qualified; accepted identities are null.
stages.name: Solver package
stages.next_required: A pinned reference package with an accepted image and manifest identity, measured per-case cost and memory, and conservation checks within packet tolerances.

stages.definition_note: Working values only; final thresholds are the owner's.
stages.name: Feasibility and value panel
stages.next_required: Value criteria V1-V5, validity criteria T1-T5 and cost criteria C1 onward evidenced for the Challenge, with a keep, reframe or replace decision recorded.
stages.owner: Codex packets the value case; Data Collection measures; Test Lead judges; owner sets final thresholds

stages.definition_note: A law sheet registers no sampler and no exposure setting.
stages.name: Question law
stages.next_required: A non-runtime law sheet (population, action lattice, strata, near rule) whose HUMAN_INPUT values the owner has accepted or declined; the four-check design-value prerequisite met before any new hidden bank.

stages.definition_note: Owner session settled by the Test Lead ruling. Entry and exit are still assembled from the hidden-pool runbook and register lessons S11 and S12, not from one stage definition.
stages.name: Bank
stages.next_required: A sealed hidden bank prepared on the hidden host from a pinned validator image, never on a host every agent session can read.
stages.owner: Carbon Validator (producer, bank adapters, VALIDATOR-28 family sources); Data Collection supplies each family's reference package and panel; the owner approves startup spend

stages.definition_note: A waiver is never a PASS and a review never turns a FAIL into one.
stages.name: Readiness gate
stages.next_required: launch_ready true at that exact SHA: no FAIL, NOT_BUILT or REVIEW_REQUIRED; waivers are stage-bound and measurement-only; reports committed through PR Head.
stages.owner: Graphite Testing Manager runs; Test Lead reviews and waives

stages.definition_note: Stage A is measurement only; L1 confirmations wait for an L1 Q1 report and VALIDATOR-25.
stages.name: Graphite stage A (L0 and L1)
stages.next_required: The checklist runs complete with a lessons entry, evidence digest and spend count per run; L0 confirmations through the Launchpad; refused-capability extracts collected; stage report to the Test Lead.
stages.owner: Executor runs; Launchpad lanes; Test Engineer bindings; Test Lead decides

stages.definition_note: Stage B's grant files do not exist; its spend line is only prepared.
stages.name: Graphite stage B (L2 and L3 on the dev-ladder)
stages.next_required: Per the stage B plan: runs complete with lessons entries and a stage summary.
stages.owner: Executor runs; Carbon Validator owns VALIDATOR-25; owner approves spend

stages.name: Graphite stage C (L4, graph only)
stages.next_required: Per the wave plan section 4a: the stage C Constructor and Attacker runs complete with lessons entries.
stages.owner: Executor runs; Level 4 engineer owns the rebuild path; owner approves spend

stages.definition_note: A working definition for development, ruled by the Test Lead. TESTED is not scientific qualification, security acceptance, LIVE or a launch claim; LIVE or qualification is a separate owner step.
stages.name: Tested Challenge
stages.next_required: TESTED when ALL hold: (1) the readiness gate is launch_ready at every enabled level (no FAIL; waivers expired or closed); (2) a sealed hidden bank exists, with exposure accounting; (3) Graphite stages are complete at every enabled level, with real Launchpad confirmations scored by a validator, and every Attacker finding dispositioned (fixed, or accepted with a reason); (4) score-value alignment is measured on confirmed recipes (a Q1 report exists), and a negative result is allowed but must trigger a scoring iteration; (5) control detection (T3) meets its target at the chosen k and E; (6) the incentive canary shows the best model weighted (INCENTIVE-CANARY-01); (7) the stage-end report is filed; (8) the cheap-baseline comparison (V4) is done: the models' decisions are compared, at matched admissibility, with the strongest cheap method a buyer would otherwise use.
